title: Consistent CutPINNs for Convection-Diffusion Equations on Curved Level-Set Domains
summary: We present an a priori error analysis of consistent-loss PINNs for stationary convection-diffusion equations on curved level-set domains. The standard mean-squared interior loss fails in the convection-dominated regime: the solution develops an $O(\eps)$ boundary layer in which the pointwise residual grows like $\eps^{-1}$, so the loss is dominated by the few collocation points inside the layer and leaves the smooth bulk unresolved.
